maintenance_led.reason: Sells process fluids and lubricants consumed in steel and metalworking operations; consumables used up, not repair or installed-base servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private steel, aluminum, automotive, aerospace and machinery manufacturers paying for process fluids.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through selling fluids and technical services; the Houghton merger was a large deal, with only occasional smaller acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Fluids are qualified into customers' production processes (e.g., Boeing approval, John Deere supplier), so switching needs requalification and risks downtime.

notes: Quaker acquires periodically, so the serial-acquirer answer is a judgment call.
